children: The retreat in Australia's housing market is starting to break records. House prices declined across every capital city for the first time in 15 years in the third quarter and for only the second time on record, according to property website Domain. The result marks the second consecutive quarterly national fall and signals a decisive loss of momentum across markets that had previously moved at markedly different speeds, it adds. Market conditions could worsen if the Reserve Bank of Australia raises interest rates further in November. Pricing for a hike is around 50%. (james.glynn@wsj.com; @JamesGlynnWSJ)
